title: Part compatibility is a tested relationship, not a label
plainLanguage: Two pieces are compatible only after we actually test how they connect, overlap, layer, and move together in the relevant view.
purpose: Make future mix-and-match assembly dependable instead of assuming every arm works with every torso.

rules.statement: Compatibility is always between a specific part, host/body family, view, and tested pose or articulation range.
Record separate outcomes for geometry, seam, layer order, silhouette, articulation, and identity preservation.
A “needs new artwork” result is valid knowledge; do not distort an incompatible piece until it appears to fit.
Use compatibility outcomes to guide future reference searches and part selection.

implementation.currentSupport: Corpus Pane can classify “needs new artwork” but does not yet run assembly tests.
implementation.futureWork: Add a small compatibility-test workflow in the doll/poser stage.
